title: Jerusalem Umami Splat
description: This comforting and chewy vegetarian-friendly dish features Jerusalem artichokes with dumplings for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the Jerusalem artichokes.
Wash and prepare dumplings according to recipe instructions. Soak them in cold water for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a wok or large skillet with vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Add garlic and stir fry for about 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.
Drain the dumplings, shaking off excess water, then add to the wok along with Jerusalem artichokes. Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and red pepper flakes. Toss well to coat ingredients evenly.
Cook until dumplings are cooked through and mixture is heated through but not overly liquidy.
Garnish with chopped scallions or cilantro if desired, then serve hot as a comforting side dish.
